It has been such a great year for the Canadian online casino market – bonuses are getting more generous, games are improving in quality, and payouts are getting bigger. 

While that’s good for players like you, it means we really had our work cut out when we picked out the best online casinos Canada has to offer.

Casino Infinity definitely stole the show with its massive game library and generous welcome offer. But its competitors are not far behind. 

Let’s take a closer look, then. 

Best Online Casinos in Canada
Casino Infinity: Best overall 
Crownplay: Top pick for live dealer games
Lucky7even: Top pick for mobile gambling
Neospin: 5,000+ online slot machines

Skycrown: Avg 10-minute payouts

So, there’s your first look at the 10 best Canadian casinos. But don’t just take our word for it at face value. Here’s a closer look at the casinos to show you what they’re all about.

1. Casino Infinity – Best Online Casino Canada Overall

Pros:

8,000+ casino games 
200 free spins with the welcome offer
Over 300 live games 
Highly compatible mobile site 
15+ ways to pay

Cons:

ADVERTISEMENT

Lower max deposit for bonus
$10,500 monthly withdrawal cap

The number one place to play online casino games in Canada right now is Casino Infinity. Let’s find out why.

Casino Game Selection: 5/5

Casino Infinity’s game selection is, impressively, over 8,000 strong. It’ll take you some time to check out all of the options here! 

Many of these are slots, and they include some of the best we’ve ever seen. Contributions from BGaming and Pragmatic Play ensure you’ll get all the big hits, like Cash Link Express Hold & Win and Big Bass Amazon Extreme.

There are a lot of progressive jackpots to check out here as well. There are dozens of ways to win $1,000,000+.

ADVERTISEMENT

Plus, most non-live games can be checked out for free in demo mode. It’s always good to be able to try out titles before you spend cash on them.

On the other side, over 300 of these games are live, so you can enjoy plenty of live poker, blackjack, baccarat, roulette, game shows, and more.

Bonus Offers & Codes: 4.8/5

If you want to play casino games, your welcome bonus at Casino Infinity will be a 100% up to C$750 matched deposit and 200 free spins. 

The maximum bonus amount is a little lower than some of our other top picks, but that’s only going to make a difference to the real high-roller type players out there. 

Other Key Factors: 4.85/5

ADVERTISEMENT

Most of the Casino Infinity game selection can be played through the mobile site, which is impressive considering how many games they offer.

You can use a mobile or a desktop device to place your deposit when you first sign up. There are over 15 deposit methods that you can pick from to do this with, which is more than enough choice. Plenty of cryptocurrencies, eWallets, and vouchers are included in that.

Payouts are typically processed on the same day, which is always good to see. However, you will encounter a payout cap of $10,500 per month. That might make things slightly awkward for the higher rollers.

Final Score: 4.9/5

The Casino Infinity game portfolio is arguably the best in Canada right now. And it’s backed up with plenty of free spins, a great mobile site, and fast payouts. All in all, this online casino is clearly the best place to be.

2. Crownplay – Best Canadian Online Casino for Live Dealer Games

Pros:

Live poker, game shows, roulette, and more
250% up to C$4,500 welcome offer
Most live games from Evolution Gaming
330 free spins included
Vouchers and eWallets are available 

Cons:

Site design could be improved
Fewer crypto altcoins supported

Those looking to enjoy their online casino gaming in the live domain will want to see the great selection of live casino games over at Crownplay. There are hundreds of them! 

ADVERTISEMENT

Casino Game Selection: 4.9/5

There are hundreds of live casino games to choose from at Crownplay. You can enjoy blackjack, roulette, baccarat, and more, as usual, but we were particularly impressed with the inclusion of several poker games and a whole bunch of game shows.

What’s even better still is that most of these games come from elite-level providers like Evolution Gaming and Pragmatic Play. These two, in particular, are responsible for creating some of the best live casino software ever produced, and you can enjoy that at Crownplay. 

When you want to take a step away from live games, you can still enjoy thousands of quality slot games, plenty of non-live table game options, and even a handful of sports betting markets if that interests you.

Bonus Offers & Codes: 4.8/5

New players at Crownplay will get a very generous 250% up to C$4,500 deposit match for the welcome bonus. This also comes with some 330 free spins and a bonus crab. 

ADVERTISEMENT

A very strong package indeed. This will be split across your first four payments, which makes it easier to claim. 

Other Key Factors: 4.8/5

Crownplay supports deposits with 13 payment methods, ranging from Bitcoin to Cash2Code. A few extra cryptocurrencies wouldn’t have gone amiss, but we’re impressed by the selection of fiat currency options.

The mobile compatibility for Crownplay is good (including for the live dealer game), but we did find the actual design of the site to be a little cheap-feeling. It’s not as visually impressive as the rest of our top picks, so you’ll have to try to look past that. 

Final Score: 4.8/5

The fact that Crownplay has the most impressive array of live dealer games we’ve seen in Canada and a generous bonus to back it up is impressive right off the bat.  

ADVERTISEMENT

>>Grab C$4,500 and 330 spins [Crownplay]

3. Lucky7even – Best Canadian Casino Online for Mobile

Pros:

C$3,000 & 200 free spins offer
More than 20 ways to pay
Features the most famous crash games
High-quality mobile site 
5,000+ total games 

Cons:

Longer card payout processing
Some game restrictions for bonus

ADVERTISEMENT

Mobile gambling is the present and future of the online casino industry in Canada, and you can get the best mobile experience by playing at Lucky7even.

Casino Game Selection: 4.8/5

Some of the most famous crash games are available to play at Lucky7even. The list includes Plinko XY, Crash, Triple Cash or Crash, and more. These are just a few examples of dozens of crash titles on the site.

These options have some of the most immersive graphic design for a thrilling game experience, and the chance for very high payouts.

Outside of crash games, Lucky7even is home to some quality slots and live casino games. In fact, there are over 5,000 games in total. However, a few of these come from game providers whose quality is harder to verify.

Bonus Offers & Codes: 4.8/5

ADVERTISEMENT

The welcome bonus package at Lucky7even can get you up to C$3,000 worth of funds and 200 free spins.

Again, this offer is divided into four deposits. The first of these doesn’t require a bonus code, but you’ll need to use PLAY2, PLAY3, and PLAY4 for the second, third, and fourth, respectively. 

There are a handful of game restrictions, though, so make sure to read the terms and conditions.

Other Key Factors: 4.8/5

There are well over 20 banking options to deposit with at Lucky7even, which is way above average. It means more players will be accommodated without moving funds around, which is always good to see. 

Many of these can also be used for payouts, and for most of them, withdrawals are processed instantly. Mastercard takes 3-5 days, VISA takes 1-3 days, and bank transfers take 5-7 days, so you’re going to need to use an eWallet if you want instant payouts.

We’re also fans of the general user experience in terms of the general site design for mobile and desktop users. It’s easy to find your way around, and most games can be played through the mobile site. 

Final Score: 4.8/5
